name: Akitsuki Shun
source:
A young man who loathes Yuuto and is obsessed with his sister Kaori. In his heart there is only the desire to dominate, and upon arriving in Phantasmagoria, he uses his skills and talents as an Etranger to rise to power in the Holy Sargios Empire.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/aselia/chara.html]jastusa.com[/url]]
